Big Data Analytics: Job Market Insights, First Quarter of 2026

Latest Release : 25 June 2026
Upcoming release : 17 November 2026

Overview Job Market Insights are quarterly releases based on the job offerings advertised online through major private recruitment platforms. This report contains key information on job offerings by major occupational groups and economic activit ies . Job Offering Advertised Online , First Quarter of 202 6 The number of online job offerings advertised in the first quarter of 2026 increased by 6.6 per cent to 626,861. Job Offering Advertised Online for Major Group Occupation Online job offerings were concentrated in the Professional category, accounting for 50.4 per cent or 315,768 job offerings in the first quarter of 2026, compared to 272,698 job offerings in the fourth quarter of 2025. Managers category recorded 99,447 job offerings, followed by Technicians and Associate Professionals with 93,987 job offerings. Higher demand was observed for Advertising and Marketing Professionals (48,186 job offerings), followed by Managing Directors and Chief Executives (26,869 job offerings), Administrative Associate Professionals (26,257 job offerings), Accountants and Auditors (24,784 job offerings), as well as Software Developers (20,089 job offerings). Job Offering Advertised Online for Economic Activities The Services sector continued to dominate, accounting for 78.8 per cent or 494,182 job offerings in the first quarter of 2026, compared to 84.4 per cent in the fourth quarter of 2025.
